value.rationale: The main mathematical issue is constructing a complete infinite tail of cyclic greedy packing seven-colorings subject to wraparound distance constraints, which are absent from the published path construction. A uniform four-residue splicing result gives an explicit eventual classification rather than a single small numerical instance. The finding does not assert a new upper bound, a new invariant, or all finite exceptions.
